title: [cpp_extension] Replace FileBaton with filelock to fix stale-lock deadlock
body:
Stack from [ghstack](https://github.com/ezyang/ghstack/tree/0.14.0) (oldest at bottom):
* __->__ #190543

FileBaton.try_acquire() creates a lock file and only removes it in a
finally, so a builder killed by SIGKILL/OOM/Slurm leaves the file behind
and every later load() spins forever in FileBaton.wait(). Replace it with
a blocking torch.utils._filelock.FileLock (an OS-level flock), which the
kernel releases when the holder dies. The build now runs inside the lock
with the version re-check, so a crashed build is retried instead of
leaving waiters to load a partial module. FileBaton is kept for BC.

Fixes #189245

Test Plan:

  python test/test_cpp_extensions_jit.py -k stale_lock
